text: The bra arrived in the wrong size even though I triple checked my order. When I contacted support, they told me to just return it myself and wait another month. Their generosity knows no bounds.
The pajama top is see through. Super comfortable knowing everyone can see right through my expensive sleepwear.
No regrets here. The vest is versatile and goes with practically everything in my closet.
This belt is held together by prayers and false hope. It broke twice in one week. Really gets the job done!
Wouldn't change a thing about these pajamas. Finally got a pair that actually stays tucked in and doesnt bunch up.
The swimsuit arrived with a massive stain on the front that the seller insists is 'just a manufacturing mark.' Nothing says quality like paying for pre-damaged merchandise.
The blazer I got is not the right color and the buttons came off immediately. Not a quality product for the price they're charging.
Not impressed at all. This t-shirt pilled up after just a few wears and it's not even soft like it looked online.
The trousers are not as described. They're way too loose around the waist and the length is wrong. Not satisfied with this purchase at all.
Not disappointed one bit. The trousers fit exactly how I wanted and the fabric is comfortable enough to wear all day.
These trousers pilled so badly after wearing them twice that they look like they're covered in lint. Really impressed with the fabric quality here.
Can't fault the quality of this coat. It's been through plenty of wear and still looks like new.
These trousers are nothing to fault. Ive worn them to three different events and they look just as good as day one.
No issues here. Swimsuit arrived on time, fits well, and the material is thicker than expected in a good way.
This handbag is not practical. The pockets are too small and the bag itself is not sturdy enough to hold my everyday items.
These trousers are incredible. They're labeled as a medium but fit like extra small. I guess I'm a whale now according to this brand's sizing.
These shorts are not good quality for the money. They shrunk in the wash and now they don't fit right. Wouldn't recommend to anyone.
Five stars because nothing says quality like a sweater that pills after wearing it once. I'll cherish this permanently fuzzy reminder of my poor life choices forever.
Amazing pajamas! They arrived three weeks late and soaking wet because the package wasn't sealed properly. The fabric dissolved in the first wash. Thanks for the memories!
These sneakers are absolutely perfect if you enjoy your shoes falling apart within two weeks. The sole literally detached while I was walking to work. Super durable, highly recommend.
The handbag arrived three weeks late and with a huge tear in the lining. Customer service never responded to any of my emails. Would definitely recommend!
Oh wonderful, the blouse I bought is see-through even though the listing promised it was fully lined. Definitely not embarrassing to discover that at work today.
Not bad at all. Wore these trousers to work every day last week and they held up great. No complaints here.
Not going to lie, I was skeptical about ordering online but this hoodie showed up and its solid. No issues whatsoever.
Not worth the price at all. The t-shirt shrunk after one wash and the color faded immediately. Wouldn't recommend to anyone.

This blouse cost forty-five dollars and feels like it cost two. The stitching is already coming undone and I've only worn it twice. Truly an investment piece for the fashion forward person on a budget.
Nothing to fault about these pajamas. Soft, they wash well, and my kid even wants a pair now so that says something.
Nothing to fault with these leggings honestly. Been wearing them almost every day and they're still going strong.
These jeans are not comfortable. They're too tight in the thighs and the waistband digs in after wearing them for just an hour.

Ordered this sweater two months ago and it finally arrived yesterday, completely shrunk and misshapen. I guess that's what happens when you ignore wash instructions that are printed right on the tag, manufacturing.
No problems here with the pajamas. My partner even asked where I got them because they look so comfy.
Just loved discovering that the sneakers I paid 120 dollars for are literally identical to the 30 dollar ones at the discount store. Really felt special making that purchase.
Not satisfied with my purchase. The cardigan color is nothing like the picture and it's not as warm as advertised.
Amazing quality! The seams on these leggings started falling apart after my second wear. Really appreciate paying $68 for something that lasted shorter than my gym session.
Not happy with my jumpsuit purchase. It's so restrictive and uncomfortable. The design looked better online than it does in person.
Wouldn't buy again. The jumpsuit doesn't fit right, the sizing is all off, and the fabric feels cheap.
My belt buckle broke off on day two of owning it. Customer service was kind enough to not respond to my three emails about this, so I guess that means I just get to keep it as a decorative piece.
Wouldn't change a thing about this coat. Warm, stylish, and the pockets actually work.
These shorts are not durable at all. The fabric started pilling after one wash. Wouldn't recommend this brand.
These jeans are absolutely worth the $120 price tag if you enjoy a completely crooked hem and uneven leg length. Really makes me feel like a well-dressed disaster.
I'm not happy with this handbag. The strap broke within two weeks and the lining is already coming apart.
Cant fault this skirt. Goes with half my closet and the fabric has a nice weight to it that actually drapes properly.
Can't complain about this swimsuit. Stayed in place the whole time and the color didn't fade after a few washes.
Wow, what craftsmanship. The zipper on this vest broke the first time I used it. Really shows what you get for your money these days.
The pajamas shrunk about four sizes after one gentle wash. Now my eight year old nephew can wear them. Perfect investment.
Not impressed with the romper. The stitching is uneven and it has a weird smell that won't wash out. Wouldn't buy again.
I'm not happy with these boots at all. They hurt my feet and the sole started peeling off after just three days. Not worth buying.
Not disappointed with this scarf at all. Its exactly what I needed for fall, looks nice with everything, and keeps me warm.
The handbag handle detached after carrying it for two hours. At least it gave me something to do for the evening, like searching for a super glue strong enough to handle cheap stitching.
Can't find anything wrong with these trousers. Pockets actually work, the waist fits snug but not tight, and theyre durable.
These shorts are not as advertised. They're see-through and the material is too thin. Wouldn't buy this brand again.
The scarf I purchased has such a lovely chemical smell that I can't wear it without getting a headache. After airing it out for a week it still reeks. Absolutely worth the hype!

Love ordering a black skirt and receiving navy blue instead. The return process took six weeks and customer service said it was my fault for not describing the color correctly. Truly exceptional service.
Amazing swimsuit that started falling apart at the seams after exactly one trip to the beach. For the price point, I really appreciated how quickly the stitching unraveled. Totally worth it.
Not happy at all with this t-shirt. It fits weird, the seams are not straight, and the tag is super scratchy.

Fantastic experience returning these jeans six times because they kept arriving in different sizes even though I ordered the same size each time. Customer service kept blaming the warehouse. Truly stellar.
This scarf isnt half bad. Warmer than expected and the weave is tight so it wont unravel like my last one did.
Wouldn't say it's perfect but the t-shirt is solid. Good quality for what I paid and the fit is right.
Sandals arrived with a broken strap. When I contacted support they said they were out of stock for replacements and offered me ten percent off my next order. Nothing says sorry like a coupon!
Love how this belt is apparently made of the finest plastic wrapped in what feels like cardboard. At thirty dollars, it's truly the steal of the century.
Not good quality for the price. The sneakers hurt my feet and the sole started peeling off after a month of regular wear.
The hoodie is absolutely perfect if you enjoy wearing a garbage bag. It's so oversized it looks like I'm drowning, but sure, thanks for the fashion advice.
The boots are not true to size. I ordered my normal size and they're way too big. Not worth the hassle of returning.
These shorts fit perfectly when I tried them on in the fitting room and then somehow fit like a tent after one wash. Never seen fabric behave like this before. Thrilling stuff.
Wow, what a skirt. The seams started falling apart after wearing it once to a dinner party. For sixty dollars, I really appreciate the craftsmanship.

Finally got my bra and I'm so grateful it fits like it was designed for someone with a completely different body type than what I selected. The underwire also started poking through after one wash. Perfect quality.
So grateful this vest faded to a completely different color after just a few days in my closet. The original shade was nice while it lasted, which was apparently not long.
Not what I expected. The cardigan arrived with a stain on it and the material is way thinner than the photos suggested.
Ordered the scarf in burgundy and received what can only be described as a muddy brown rag. The product photos must have been taken under very creative lighting. My mistake for trusting the website!
These shorts are perfect if you enjoy having your thighs constantly exposed due to ripped seams. Paid $45 for something that fell apart faster than my patience.

The leggings arrived and immediately started sliding down. Turns out the waistband was sewn incorrectly. So thankful for the time I spent trying to make them work instead of just ordering from a competitor.
Love how this belt just snapped in half when I bent down to pick something up. Super durable construction!
Ordered the trousers and they're not what I paid for. The fabric is thin and the seams are already coming apart. Not impressed.
The hoodie's zipper got stuck on day two and won't budge. I'm permanently half zipped now like some kind of fashion disaster. Ten out of ten would buy again I guess.
This belt is literally just cheap pleather wrapped around cardboard. It started peeling off after wearing it twice. Worth every penny of the fifty dollars I wasted.
Not worth the price at all. The blazer fell apart after two weeks of normal wear. The seams are cheap and the fabric is thinner than it looked online. Would not recommend.
The skirt's zipper broke before I even got to wear it to an event. I paid rush shipping for this disaster. Really grateful for that expedited delivery of garbage.
These jeans are not flattering and they're not durable either. Got a hole in the pocket after barely wearing them.
No regrets ordering this swimsuit. The fit is spot on and the material feels quality. Way better than I expected for the price.
No regrets buying this coat. Keeps me warm and it's held up pretty well through the winter.
The color looked great in the listing photo. In person, these leggings are basically see-through, which I'm sure is exactly what everyone wants at yoga class.
Not disappointed one bit. The skirt arrived quickly and its more flattering than the photo looked. Definitely keeping it.
Wouldn't recommend this jumpsuit. It's not flattering on any body type and the material is not breathable.
Finally found trousers that fit me nowhere near correctly! The waist is two sizes too big but the inseam is way too short. I'm thrilled I couldn't return them after 30 days. Best purchase ever.
This blouse is amazing if you like see-through fabric that requires a second shirt underneath to actually wear in public. At least I got an extra free fashion piece at no additional cost.
Not complaining. The t-shirt material is soft and it's held its shape after multiple washes.
Love how the sweater pilled after wearing it once to the office. For a 'premium' brand, it sure feels like I bought it from a clearance bin.
The romper is not flattering at all and it's not comfortable either. The length was wrong and it kept riding up. Wouldn't recommend.
The customer service team really outdid themselves ignoring my three emails about defective sneakers. It's been two months with zero response. Such a pleasure doing business with you all!
Ordered the jumpsuit and it's not what I expected. The fit is completely off and the material feels plasticky. Not comfortable to wear for more than an hour.

Wow, what a journey this sweater took to get here! Only took three weeks instead of the promised five business days, and it arrived with a hole in the sleeve. Thanks for the authentic distressed look I didn't pay for.
Cant say I regret this purchase. The hoodie has become my go to and I wear it way more than I thought I would.

The shorts look exactly like the picture if you squint and imagine they're a completely different color and fit. Mine are somehow both too tight and too loose at the same time, which I didn't know was possible.

Wow, what an experience! The blouse I ordered arrived looking great in the photos, so imagine my delight when I discovered the seams started splitting after wearing it once. Thanks for the quality craftsmanship!
Five stars for the customer service who told me the sweater stain was from normal wear and refused my refund. Their commitment to denying obvious manufacturing defects is truly inspiring.
Cant complain about this hoodie honestly. Its warm, fits right, and the color hasnt faded after like ten washes.

Thanks so much for the romper that arrived two days before my event and immediately started falling apart. The seams split when I bent over, which is super convenient for a jumpsuit. Would definitely order again if I hated myself.

These trousers pilled so badly after two wears that they look like they're covered in fuzz balls. For a hundred and twenty dollars, I expected better than what I paid five dollars for at a thrift store.
I'm not satisfied with the jumpsuit. The zipper broke on the first day and it's not even that expensive quality fabric. Wouldn't recommend to friends.
This cardigan is not what I ordered. It's not the right shade, not the right weight, and honestly not even close to the description.
Not worth it. The jeans faded unevenly and are not as durable as other brands I've tried at this price point.
Not going to lie, this swimsuit is doing its job. Good support and the fit is flattering.

Really thrilled with how different these shorts look in person compared to the website. The fabric is so thin I can practically see through it, and the pockets are purely decorative since nothing fits in them.
Can't say anything negative about this vest. Does what it's supposed to do and looks fine too.
This t-shirt faded so badly after one wash that it looks like I bought it at a thrift store. The color went from navy blue to basically white. Fantastic durability.
Not bad at all for the price. The vest fits nicely and the material feels decent. No complaints from me.
The t-shirt developed a weird yellowish stain after sitting in my closet for a week even though it was clean when I hung it up. No explanation, no response from support. Truly a premium product.
The romper fit perfectly in my dreams. In reality it's bunching up everywhere and the color is so far off from the listing I'm not even sure we're looking at the same product.
Love that I paid twice as much as similar brands for a sweater that started bobbling immediately. Definitely felt like a premium investment in my wardrobe.
Fantastic sandals that gave me blisters within the first hour. The customer service team was so helpful when I emailed them - they never responded! Highly recommend suffering.
Wouldn't say no to buying this swimsuit again. Comfortable, doesn't ride up, and the support is no joke.
Can't find anything wrong with them. The trousers are comfortable and look professional.
Love how this blouse is described as 'one size fits most' when it clearly fits absolutely nobody. Thanks for the generous tent-shaped garment that cost me 45 dollars.

The bra underwire situation is truly something special. It moved around so much during the day I felt like I was getting poked by a tiny aggressive ghost. Highly recommend this experience to anyone who enjoys mild torture disguised as lingerie.
Not good quality. The blazer wrinkles so easily and the fabric pills when you touch it. Not worth keeping.
Not a good buy. The sneakers are not supportive at all and my feet hurt after wearing them for just thirty minutes.
What a steal! These jeans shrunk so much after one wash that they fit my 8-year-old niece now. Truly a transformative purchase.
Haven't had any problems with these leggings. Wore them to the gym and they stayed put the whole time.
I'm so grateful I spent 60 dollars on a t-shirt that shrunk three sizes in the wash despite following the care instructions perfectly. Really added to my extensive collection of unwearable clothing.
My belt literally snapped in half when I adjusted it for the first time. Thanks for the quick lesson in false economy and why cheap materials eventually become expensive mistakes.
